issue_context.title: pi_hole.enable/disable not working without active authentifiaction on pihole
issue_context.body:

  - If you need additional help with this template, please refer to https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/

-->
## The problem
I run pihole in my local network without a password. Therefore there is no API-Key for pi hole. Using anything but an empty auth parameter on pihole will deny access.
Providing no API-Key to the pi_hole integration leads to 

Logger: homeassistant.components.pi_hole
Source: components/pi_hole/__init__.py:121
Integration: Pi-hole (documentation, issues)
First occurred: 17:50:00 (5 occurrences)
Last logged: 17:55:14

**Pi-hole Pi-Hole must have an api_key provided in configuration to be enabled**

Either either this check should be removed or a checkbox for "empty password" included in the setup flow.

## Environment
Pi-hole Version v5.0 Web Interface Version v5.0


- Home Assistant Core release with the issue:  Home Assistant 0.111.4
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): 
- Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core): FreeBSD/FreeNAS Jail
- Integration causing this issue: pi_hole


## Traceback/Error logs
<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

```txt
2020-06-30 17:55:14 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.pi_hole] Pi-hole Pi-Hole must have an api_key provided in configuration to be enabled
```

## Additional information
comments:
Hey there @fabaff, @johnluetke, @shenxn, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`pi_hole`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L313) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Does the Pi-Hole not still provide an API key if you have no password? Also, the service is going to be deprecated soon in favor of a switch. However the switch has the same limitation you’re describing.

Pihole returns
`No password set` when requesting an API key from the ui.
AFAIK the API key is just the pre-hashed version of the password
@daniel-a-h We are adding switch to the pi_hole integration (#35605). I'll try to handle the empty password situation in that PR or a separated one.

review_comments: Since one value is derived from the other, why store both?

For config entries imported from the YAML configuration, not providing API key means statistics only. However, for config entries created through UI, this is not always the case. We store both values here so that the config entries always have the same structure, which makes setting up the entries easier.
